features.title: Microservices architecture and contracts are documented
features.user_visible_behavior: A contributor or agent can read the system diagram, service boundaries, data ownership, and per-service ERDs and understand how the platform fits together.
verification: Confirm openspec/architecture/system-context.md contains a mermaid diagram covering all six services, Traefik, and databases.
Confirm every service has an ERD mermaid diagram under openspec/architecture/erd/.
Confirm openspec/architecture/README.md links every diagram and the contracts.
evidence: openspec/architecture/service-catalog.md: six services with responsibility, database, and API surface
openspec/architecture/system-context.md: mermaid diagram plus withdrawal and reporting paths
openspec/architecture/erd/: six mermaid ERDs with keys, constraints, and external references
openspec/architecture/integration-contract.md: gateway, identity, idempotency, errors, ownership, and reporting contracts
features.notes: Foundation feature for the microservices platform.

features.title: PEN withdrawal service is implemented and tested
features.user_visible_behavior: An authenticated client can create, query, and cancel PEN withdrawal requests with idempotency, domain limits, and transaction reporting.
verification: Run the withdrawal-soles pytest suite and confirm all tests pass.
Start the service and confirm GET /health returns 200.
Create a valid withdrawal and confirm it is persisted and reported to transaction-service.
Replay the same Idempotency-Key and confirm no duplicate operation is created.
features.notes: Only this service is implemented in this repository.

features.title: AWS EKS cluster is provisioned with Terraform
features.user_visible_behavior: A cloud engineer can run Terraform to create the VPC, EKS cluster, managed node group, ECR repository, and PostgreSQL database required by the platform.
verification: Run terraform init -backend=false and terraform validate successfully.
Confirm terraform plan renders the VPC, EKS cluster, node group, ECR repository, and RDS instance.
Confirm outputs expose cluster name, endpoint, and database endpoint.
features.notes: Terraform-only scope; application deployment manifests are a follow-up.
